change: Pin active Rust and Python Symbolica dependencies to the requested main revision; compare unchanged benchmark driver with the optimized registry-3.0.0 baseline.

revision.selection: Updated main HEAD containing the user's upstream Wasm fix; immutable commit pinned

baseline.description: Final local-metric normalization and no-op visitor optimization with crates.io Symbolica 3.0.0.
baseline.timing_provenance: Fresh measurement of the exact archived registry executable, immediately before the main measurement. Historical timing samples remain unchanged in dot_normalization.json.

timing_method: Fresh sequential registry baseline then pinned main; five warm samples per method, rotating method order, adaptive batches targeting 8 ms, output destruction included. CPU 6 on a shared host. Our native validation/compiler group was suspended for both runs and resumed afterward; unrelated host load remains uncontrolled. API timings exclude initial parsing/construction; parse_only and parse_and_normalize_dots include it. Builds were not interleaved.

measurement_run.timing_note: Fresh sequential registry baseline then main on CPU6, five warm samples each. Our native validation/compiler group was suspended for both runs and resumed in finally. Shared host remains uncontrolled.

snapshot_scope: Plain-text source/input/output snapshot hashes; differing small outputs are embedded. Equality checks compare symbolic outputs, independently of binary atom serialization. Recreate complete snapshots by running the driver.

form.provenance: Reused unchanged FORM 5.0.0 measurements and programs from the preceding dot-normalization comparison; FORM was not rerun for this dependency update.

methodology.wall: One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.
methodology.cpu: FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.
methodology.counts: Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial. This artifact reuses that earlier untimed run; fresh timing processes also check the expected sorted-term count in every batch.
methodology.scope: Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.
methodology.host: Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.

script.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/symbolica-main-update/tydenso-patched-payload/tydenso
check_dir=/tmp/symbolica-main-update/tymbolica-interop/check-run
tymbolica_checkout="$check_dir/tymbolica"
cmp typst/render.typ /common/dev/gammaloop/feynkit-rich-display/crates/spynso3/typst/render.typ
cmp typst/notation.typ /common/dev/gammaloop/feynkit-rich-display/crates/spynso3/typst/notation.typ

# Nix wrappers may set a read-only package cache; allow both Parsely versions.
package_root="$check_dir/xdg/typst/packages/local"
mkdir -p \
  "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0" \
  "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0"
cp -R typst/. "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0/"
cp "$tymbolica_checkout/typst.toml" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/typst.toml"
cp -R "$tymbolica_checkout/symbolica" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/symbolica"

for source in typst/examples/*.typ typst/tests/*.typ; do
  case "$source" in
    typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ) continue ;;
  esac
  output="$check_dir/$(basename "${source%.typ}").pdf"
  XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . "$source" "$output"
done

gamma_order_error="$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.error"
if XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . \
  typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ \
  "$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.pdf" >"$gamma_order_error" 2>&1; then
  echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports unexpectedly compiled" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "gamma first argument must be a bispinor slot" "$gamma_order_error"; then
  echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports failed for an unexpected reason" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Keep the target-aware phantom helper exercised: HTML must retain
# semantic MathML and use mphantom, while SVG remains directly renderable.
XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --features html --format html \
  --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.html"
grep -q '<math' "$check_dir/basic.html"
phantom_count="$(grep -o '<mphantom' "$check_dir/basic.html" | wc -l)"
if [ "$phantom_count" -ne 7 ]; then
  echo "expected 7 semantic mphantom alignment nodes, found $phantom_count" >&2
  exit 1
fi
XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --format svg \
  --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.svg"
test -s "$check_dir/basic.svg"

XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" \
  --creation-timestamp 0 --root . typst/manual.typ "$check_dir/manual.pdf"
cmp typst/manual.pdf "$check_dir/manual.pdf"

# Tydenso's Rust crates are deliberately isolated from GammaLoop's native
# workspace so Cargo cannot unify native Symbolica features into this Wasm graph.

build:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "{{ justfile_directory() }}/tydenso"

    target="wasm32-unknown-unknown"
    output_dir="target/$target/release"
    size_limit=10485760

    cargo build --release --target "$target" --package tydenso-inflate-plugin --lib
    wasm-opt -Oz --quiet \
      --enable-bulk-memory \
      --enable-bulk-memory-opt \
      --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int \
      --enable-simd \
      --strip-debug \
      --strip-producers \
      -o typst/tydenso-inflate.wasm \
      "$output_dir/tydenso_inflate_plugin.wasm"

    cargo build --release --target "$target" --package tydenso-plugin
    wasm-opt -Oz --quiet \
      --enable-bulk-memory \
      --enable-bulk-memory-opt \
      --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int \
      --enable-simd \
      --strip-debug \
      --strip-producers \
      -o "$output_dir/tydenso.raw.wasm" \
      "$output_dir/tydenso_plugin.wasm"
    cargo run --release --package tydenso-inflate-plugin --bin tydenso-compress -- \
      "$output_dir/tydenso.raw.wasm" typst/tydenso.wasm.zlib

    for asset in typst/tydenso-inflate.wasm typst/tydenso.wasm.zlib; do
      size="$(wc -c < "$asset")"
      if [ "$size" -ge "$size_limit" ]; then
        echo "$asset is $size bytes; every Typst plugin asset must remain below 10 MiB" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ls -lh "$asset"
    done

# Verify that no native arithmetic backend leaked into the target-side graph.
check-wasm-features:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "{{ justfile_directory() }}/tydenso"
    tree="$(cargo tree --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --package tydenso-plugin --edges normal --prefix none -e features)"
    if grep -Eq 'feature "(integer-gmp|float-mpfr|native_code_generation)"|(gmp-mpfr-sys|rug) v|gammaloop-workspace-hack' <<<"$tree"; then
      echo "Tydenso's target graph contains native-only dependencies" >&2
      printf '%s\n' "$tree" >&2
      exit 1
    fi

# Rebuild the deterministic user manual after the plugin assets have changed.
manual: build
    cd "{{ justfile_directory() }}/tydenso" && typst compile --creation-timestamp 0 --root . typst/manual.typ typst/manual.pdf

# Compile the full package surface. Interop checks use a sibling Symbolica Typst plugin
# checkout by default; override TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT for a differently placed tree.
check: build check-wasm-features
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "{{ justfile_directory() }}/tydenso"
    tymbolica_checkout="${TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT:-../../symbolica-typst-plugin}"
    tymbolica_revision="18e0491628f9eac5c788659cabfcdb7575f6986d"
    if [ ! -f "$tymbolica_checkout/typst.toml" ]; then
      echo "set TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT to the pinned symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin checkout" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    checkout_revision="$(git -C "$tymbolica_checkout" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ "$checkout_revision" != "$tymbolica_revision" ]; then
      echo "TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT must be at $tymbolica_revision; found ${checkout_revision:-no Git HEAD}" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    symbolica_version="3.0.0"
    check_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
    trap 'rm -rf "$check_dir"' EXIT
    mkdir -p "$check_dir/tymbolica" ../target/tymbolica
    git -C "$tymbolica_checkout" archive "$tymbolica_revision" | tar -x -C "$check_dir/tymbolica"
    tymbolica_checkout="$check_dir/tymbolica"
    # Rebuild the pinned combined algebra/integration engine without changing the checkout.
    # Its build script reads Cargo's target and feature settings; generated plugin
    # assets remain outside the Rust source inputs.
    # Keep compilation reusable outside Swatinem's workspace-target cleanup.
    ln -s "$PWD/../target/tymbolica" "$tymbolica_checkout/target"
    (
      cd "$tymbolica_checkout"
      unset CARGO_TARGET_DIR
      nix run --no-write-lock-file "path:$PWD#build"
    )
    expected="$(printf 'version = "%s"\nsource = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"\n' "$symbolica_version")"
    for lock in ../Cargo.lock Cargo.lock "$tymbolica_checkout/Cargo.lock"; do
      for package in symbolica numerica graphica; do
        resolved="$(sed -n "/^name = \"$package\"$/,/^\[\[package\]\]/p" "$lock" | grep -E '^(version|source) = ')"
        if [ "$resolved" != "$expected" ]; then
          echo "$lock must resolve exactly one crates.io $package at $symbolica_version; found ${resolved:-none}" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
      done
    done
    cmp typst/render.typ ../crates/spynso3/typst/render.typ
    cmp typst/notation.typ ../crates/spynso3/typst/notation.typ

    # Nix wrappers may set a read-only package cache; allow both Parsely versions.
    package_root="$check_dir/xdg/typst/packages/local"
    mkdir -p \
      "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0" \
      "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0"
    cp -R typst/. "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0/"
    cp "$tymbolica_checkout/typst.toml" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/typst.toml"
    cp -R "$tymbolica_checkout/symbolica" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/symbolica"

    for source in typst/examples/*.typ typst/tests/*.typ; do
      case "$source" in
        typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ) continue ;;
      esac
      output="$check_dir/$(basename "${source%.typ}").pdf"
      XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . "$source" "$output"
    done

    gamma_order_error="$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.error"
    if XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . \
      typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ \
      "$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.pdf" >"$gamma_order_error" 2>&1; then
      echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports unexpectedly compiled" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! grep -q "gamma first argument must be a bispinor slot" "$gamma_order_error"; then
      echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports failed for an unexpected reason" >&2
      exit 1
    fi

    # Keep the target-aware phantom helper exercised: HTML must retain
    # semantic MathML and use mphantom, while SVG remains directly renderable.
    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --features html --format html \
      --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.html"
    grep -q '<math' "$check_dir/basic.html"
    phantom_count="$(grep -o '<mphantom' "$check_dir/basic.html" | wc -l)"
    if [ "$phantom_count" -ne 7 ]; then
      echo "expected 7 semantic mphantom alignment nodes, found $phantom_count" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --format svg \
      --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.svg"
    test -s "$check_dir/basic.svg"

    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" \
      --creation-timestamp 0 --root . typst/manual.typ "$check_dir/manual.pdf"
    cmp typst/manual.pdf "$check_dir/manual.pdf"

# Tydenso

Tydenso is GammaLoop's Typst interface to Spenso and Idenso. Its nested Cargo
workspace intentionally keeps the WebAssembly dependency graph separate from
GammaLoop's native Python and command-line builds.

The complete Typst package lives in [`typst`](typst), including its manual,
examples, tests, compressed engine, and small inflater plugin. Build and check
it from the repository root with:

```sh
just tydenso::build
TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT=/path/to/symbolica-typst-plugin just tydenso::check
just tydenso::manual
```

The interop tests require `TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT` to point to
[`symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin`](https://github.com/symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin) at Git HEAD
`18e0491628f9eac5c788659cabfcdb7575f6986d`, the exact Symbolica Typst plugin revision pinned
by the nested Rust workspace. The check uses Nix to rebuild its combined algebra and integration engine
in a temporary copy. GammaLoop, Tydenso and the Typst plugin must all resolve
Symbolica, Numerica and Graphica `3.0.0` from crates.io.
It preserves the checkout and reuses compiled dependencies in
`target/tymbolica` at the repository root. The Rust payload dependency comes
from the same pinned Git revision.

Tydenso is licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE) carried in this directory.

# Compile the full package surface. Interop checks use a sibling Symbolica Typst plugin
# checkout by default; override TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT for a differently placed tree.
check: build check-wasm-features
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "{{ justfile_directory() }}/tydenso"
    tymbolica_checkout="${TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT:-../../symbolica-typst-plugin}"
    tymbolica_revision="18e0491628f9eac5c788659cabfcdb7575f6986d"
    if [ ! -f "$tymbolica_checkout/typst.toml" ]; then
      echo "set TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT to the pinned symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin checkout" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    checkout_revision="$(git -C "$tymbolica_checkout" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ "$checkout_revision" != "$tymbolica_revision" ]; then
      echo "TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT must be at $tymbolica_revision; found ${checkout_revision:-no Git HEAD}" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    symbolica_version="3.0.0"
    symbolica_git="$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr '(builtins.fromTOML (builtins.readFile ../Cargo.toml)).patch.crates-io.symbolica.git')"
    symbolica_revision="$(nix eval --impure --raw --expr '(builtins.fromTOML (builtins.readFile ../Cargo.toml)).patch.crates-io.symbolica.rev')"
    check_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
    trap 'rm -rf "$check_dir"' EXIT
    mkdir -p "$check_dir/tymbolica" ../target/tymbolica
    git -C "$tymbolica_checkout" archive "$tymbolica_revision" | tar -x -C "$check_dir/tymbolica"
    tymbolica_checkout="$check_dir/tymbolica"
    # Atom payloads require the same storage format in all three engines. Apply
    # the root's pin only to this copy, preserving the plugin's Wasm features.
    cat >> "$tymbolica_checkout/Cargo.toml" <<EOF

    [patch.crates-io]
    symbolica = { git = "$symbolica_git", rev = "$symbolica_revision" }
    EOF
    # Rebuild the pinned combined algebra/integration engine without changing the checkout.
    # Its build script reads Cargo's target and feature settings; generated plugin
    # assets remain outside the Rust source inputs.
    # Keep compilation reusable outside Swatinem's workspace-target cleanup.
    ln -s "$PWD/../target/tymbolica" "$tymbolica_checkout/target"
    (
      cd "$tymbolica_checkout"
      unset CARGO_TARGET_DIR
      nix run --no-write-lock-file "path:$PWD#build"
    )
    for lock in ../Cargo.lock Cargo.lock "$tymbolica_checkout/Cargo.lock"; do
      for package in symbolica numerica graphica; do
        source="registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"
        if [ "$package" = symbolica ]; then
          source="git+$symbolica_git?rev=$symbolica_revision#$symbolica_revision"
        fi
        expected="$(printf 'version = "%s"\nsource = "%s"\n' "$symbolica_version" "$source")"
        resolved="$(sed -n "/^name = \"$package\"$/,/^\[\[package\]\]/p" "$lock" | grep -E '^(version|source) = ')"
        if [ "$resolved" != "$expected" ]; then
          echo "$lock must resolve exactly one $package at $symbolica_version from $source; found ${resolved:-none}" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
      done
    done
    tree="$(cargo tree --locked --manifest-path "$tymbolica_checkout/Cargo.toml" --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --package symbolica-typst-plugin --edges normal --prefix none -e features)"
    if grep -Eq 'feature "(integer-gmp|float-mpfr|native_code_generation)"|(gmp-mpfr-sys|rug) v|gammaloop-workspace-hack' <<<"$tree"; then
      echo "Tymbolica's target graph contains native-only dependencies" >&2
      printf '%s\n' "$tree" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    cmp typst/render.typ ../crates/spynso3/typst/render.typ
    cmp typst/notation.typ ../crates/spynso3/typst/notation.typ

    # Nix wrappers may set a read-only package cache; allow both Parsely versions.
    package_root="$check_dir/xdg/typst/packages/local"
    mkdir -p \
      "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0" \
      "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0"
    cp -R typst/. "$package_root/tydenso/0.1.0/"
    cp "$tymbolica_checkout/typst.toml" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/typst.toml"
    cp -R "$tymbolica_checkout/symbolica" "$package_root/symbolica/0.1.0/symbolica"

    for source in typst/examples/*.typ typst/tests/*.typ; do
      case "$source" in
        typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ) continue ;;
      esac
      output="$check_dir/$(basename "${source%.typ}").pdf"
      XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . "$source" "$output"
    done

    gamma_order_error="$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.error"
    if XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --root . \
      typst/tests/gamma-storage-order-invalid.typ \
      "$check_dir/gamma-storage-order-invalid.pdf" >"$gamma_order_error" 2>&1; then
      echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports unexpectedly compiled" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! grep -q "gamma first argument must be a bispinor slot" "$gamma_order_error"; then
      echo "Lorentz-first explicit gamma ports failed for an unexpected reason" >&2
      exit 1
    fi

    # Keep the target-aware phantom helper exercised: HTML must retain
    # semantic MathML and use mphantom, while SVG remains directly renderable.
    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --features html --format html \
      --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.html"
    grep -q '<math' "$check_dir/basic.html"
    phantom_count="$(grep -o '<mphantom' "$check_dir/basic.html" | wc -l)"
    if [ "$phantom_count" -ne 7 ]; then
      echo "expected 7 semantic mphantom alignment nodes, found $phantom_count" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" --format svg \
      --root . typst/examples/basic.typ "$check_dir/basic.svg"
    test -s "$check_dir/basic.svg"

    XDG_DATA_HOME="$check_dir/xdg" typst compile --package-cache-path "$check_dir/typst-cache" \
      --creation-timestamp 0 --root . typst/manual.typ "$check_dir/manual.pdf"
    cmp typst/manual.pdf "$check_dir/manual.pdf"

# Tydenso

Tydenso is GammaLoop's Typst interface to Spenso and Idenso. Its nested Cargo
workspace intentionally keeps the WebAssembly dependency graph separate from
GammaLoop's native Python and command-line builds.

The complete Typst package lives in [`typst`](typst), including its manual,
examples, tests, compressed engine, and small inflater plugin. Build and check
it from the repository root with:

```sh
just tydenso::build
TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT=/path/to/symbolica-typst-plugin just tydenso::check
just tydenso::manual
```

The interop tests require `TYMBOLICA_CHECKOUT` to point to
[`symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin`](https://github.com/symbolica-dev/symbolica-typst-plugin) at Git HEAD
`18e0491628f9eac5c788659cabfcdb7575f6986d`, the exact Symbolica Typst plugin revision pinned
by the nested Rust workspace. The check uses Nix to rebuild its combined algebra and integration engine
in a temporary copy. GammaLoop, Tydenso and the Typst plugin must all resolve
the same Symbolica Git revision from the root workspace's patch, so their
Atom payload formats agree; Numerica and Graphica remain at crates.io `3.0.0`.
It preserves the checkout and reuses compiled dependencies in
`target/tymbolica` at the repository root. The Rust payload dependency comes
from the same pinned Git revision.

See the [Tydenso manual source](typst/manual.typ) for the public Typst interface.

Tydenso is licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE) carried in this directory.

audit.scope: Read-only source audit of visitor, replacement traversal, argument access, normalization callbacks and local binary-layout dependencies. No Cargo, runtime benchmarks or production changes.

findings.result: src/id.rs, src/atom/core.rs and src/utils.rs are byte-identical. Existing public APIs and Settable changed semantics are unchanged. There is no prune-without-change replacement API; the no-op guard remains applicable.

ListIterator overrides nth with inline bounds checking and next calls, adds a precise size_hint, uses usize counts, and yields the final item from the entire remaining slice without scanning it. The previous default nth advance_by/try_fold overhead is addressed by source implementation.

Functions replace fixed-u32 byte lengths with packed-u64 lengths; products use packed argument-count/byte-length headers. Common small headers use direct fast paths. Existing accessors call specialized numerator/denominator readers and function/list skip routines. No public fused head-plus-argument accessor is introduced.

Normalization copies a function argument encoding in one block when every argument is normalized and no arg(...) flattening is required. FunctionBuilder.add_args batches through add_args_iter instead of repeated add_arg.

Atom export format changes from0 to1; old format0 is explicitly rejected by Atom read and bincode decode. Existing binary Atom/state caches require regeneration or conversion through strings using the old version. Text fixtures are unaffected by this format change.

No hard-coded atom-header decoder was found in Idenso/Spenso production code. The last-argument reproducer derives offsets from actual slices. Idenso cook.rs reversible_name hashes raw atom bytes, so cooked names change after the storage migration.

Keep the current direct slot recognizer and guard. Their public APIs remain supported. Do not infer end-to-end speedup from source changes; use the parent-owned matched benchmark after the dependency rebuild.
